title: Regolith & Surface Properties coverage matrix
notes: Machine-readable body x feature coverage for D06 only. Not a global or exhaustive survey.
Earth SoilGrids values are 250 m model predictions, not local measurements. Q0.05/Q0.95 are prediction-quantile uncertainty evidence, not independent scored features.

No fabricated values, no zero-fill, no model-predictions-as-measurements, no DEM/roughness/WorldCover inference, and no Earth-to-Moon/Mars transfer. Missing stays missing; no_coverage/unsupported explicit.
Validated Earth 0-5 cm SoilGrids means for all 113 committed Earth fine-candidate AOIs are kept (113/113).

soil_clay_0_5cm_mean.actual_indexed_queryable_coverage: 113/113 committed Earth fine-candidate AOIs have 0-5 cm mean observations across committed D06 pilots (unique area_ids=113; pilots: d06_earth_soilgrids, d06_earth_soilgrids_depths, d06_earth_soilgrids_expansion_01, d06_earth_soilgrids_all_0_5cm).
soil_clay_0_5cm_mean.time_support: static model prediction release; no time series
soil_clay_0_5cm_mean.spatial_support: AOI-envelope mean of native 250 m SoilGrids cells; not a point/local sample
soil_clay_0_5cm_mean.crs: EPSG:4326 bbox/subsetting; native 250 m model grid
soil_clay_0_5cm_mean.qa: Per-release request logs, QA groups, SHA-256 checksums and manifests (see provenance_files)
soil_clay_0_5cm_mean.uncertainty: Companion Q0.05/Q0.95 records at same area/property/depth are uncertainty evidence only
soil_clay_0_5cm_mean.legal_score_filter_roles: Source observations evidence_only; gated 0-5 cm means eligible for similarity/hard_filter under exact support/version/depth/statistic gates (Earth-only, exact area join). Q05/Q95 not scored.
soil_clay_0_5cm_mean.gaps: Bounded to committed candidates (not global); model prediction not measurement; deeper intervals not universal for all 113 AOIs
soil_clay_0_5cm_mean.rebuild_instructions: uv run python scripts/import_typed_release.py --release pipelines/pilots/d06_earth_soilgrids_all_0_5cm --database var/analog.db (and related D06 releases as needed); rebuild via scripts/build_soilgrids_depth_pilot.py with bounded area IDs/depths/statistics and --resume (network) or --dry-run
